What is the interest rate for a Home Loa: Current Home Loan interest rates start from 8.40% per annum for floating rate options, linked to the repo rate.
What is the interest rate for a Personal: Current Personal Loan interest rates range from 10.50% to 18.00% per annum, depending on your income and credit profile.
What is the interest rate for a Vehicle: Current Vehicle Loan interest rates start from 8.75% per annum for new cars and 12.00% for pre-owned cars.
What is the interest rate for an Educati: Current Education Loan interest rates start from 9.20% per annum, with special concessionary rates for female students.
What is the interest rate for a Business: Current Business Loan interest rates range from 11.25% to 16.00% per annum for unsecured business financing options.
What is a fixed interest rate?: A fixed interest rate remains constant throughout the loan tenure, protecting you from future market rate hikes.
What is a floating interest rate?: A floating interest rate fluctuates over the loan tenure in response to market changes and central bank benchmark updates.
What is MCLR?: MCLR stands for Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rate, which is the internal benchmark rate below which a bank cannot lend.
What is EBLR?: EBLR stands for External Benchmark Lending Rate, which links interest rates directly to external targets like the RBI repo rate.
What is repo rate?: The repo rate is the interest rate at which the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) lends money to commercial banks.
Does my credit score affect the interest: Yes, applicants with a credit score of 750+ are offered the lowest interest rates, as they represent a lower risk of default.
What is a repo linked lending rate?: A Repo Linked Lending Rate (RLLR) means your loan's interest rate automatically adjusts whenever the RBI changes its repo rate.
How often do floating interest rates cha: Floating rates adjust according to the benchmark resets, usually every 3 months for repo-linked loans.
What is compounding of interest?: Compounding means interest is calculated on both the initial principal and the accumulated unpaid interest over the period.
Is there an interest subsidy for student: Yes, eligible students from economically weaker sections can receive interest subsidies during their study period under government schemes.
What is interest rate concession?: A concession is a rate reduction (often 0.05%) offered to female borrowers or defense personnel.
What is simple interest?: Simple interest is calculated solely on the outstanding principal balance, common during the moratorium period of student loans.
What is a flat interest rate?: A flat rate calculates interest on the full initial loan amount throughout the tenure, which is more expensive than reducing balance rates.
What is a reducing balance interest rate: A reducing balance rate calculates interest monthly on the outstanding balance, meaning your interest component drops as you pay off the principal.
Is the interest rate negotiable?: Yes, if you have a high income, excellent credit history, or maintain a long-standing banking relationship, you can negotiate lower rates.
What is base rate?: The Base Rate is the minimum interest rate set by the bank, which was the older benchmark before MCLR and EBLR were introduced.
Are there processing fee waivers?: Yes, banks often waive processing fees during festive promotional campaigns or for pre-approved corporate clients.
What is a floating rate reset clause?: It is the term in your loan agreement defining when and how often the bank will adjust the floating rate based on benchmark changes.
Do business loans have fixed or floating: Most unsecured business loans have fixed interest rates, whereas secured business loans can have floating rates.
What is the gold loan interest rate?: Current Gold Loan interest rates start from 9.50% per annum, making it cheaper than an unsecured personal loan.
